_comment: Model acceptance criteria, fixed BEFORE any evaluation (2026-10-12). Status: PROPOSED by the implementation; must be reviewed and signed off by the capstone adviser and an agricultural/veterinary expert before the first model is approved. All metrics are computed on the held-out temporal test set only.

rationale.high_risk_recall: Missing a genuinely High Risk condition is the costliest error, so it carries the strictest bound.
rationale.good_when_high_risk: Displaying a reassuring 'Good' for a High Risk condition must be rare.
rationale.baseline: A model must clearly outperform always predicting the most frequent class.
